summary: Iteration 13 - Backend hardening (Motor timeouts + /api/health + seed wait_for) fully validated. 14/14 pytest tests pass. Health endpoint returns correct shape in <4s, no secret leakage, mongo=ok, menu_items_count=40, all 5 integration booleans/values populated. Menu/categories/settings fast-path unchanged (menu returns 40 items <2s, 9 categories, singleton settings). Startup completes in ~2s (no hang). Static verification confirms asyncio.wait_for(timeout=12.0) around run_seed with separate TimeoutError catch, and Motor client uses serverSelectionTimeoutMS=4000/connectTimeoutMS=4000/socketTimeoutMS=8000. Full regression green: admin login/me, checkout/session pickup with cash, delivery-fees stats, force-reseed, telegram webhook 401 without secret / 200 with correct secret.

/api/health returns mongo error strings that include exception message truncated to 200 chars - safe today but ensure future exception messages never embed connection strings/credentials.
asyncio import is done inside on_startup and health() - fine but could be a top-level import for consistency.

Reuse as smoke test. Note checkout payload item requires keys: line_id, kind='menu_item', item_id, qty (NOT menu_item_id).
rca of the issue: Production 504 on GET /api/menu was root-caused externally by user: production MONGO_URL points to a Mongo cluster unreachable from the container. Motor's default 30s serverSelectionTimeoutMS caused the 30s hang. This iteration's fix in preview code: (a) hard timeouts on Motor client (4s/4s/8s) so future misconfig fails fast; (b) startup seed wrapped in asyncio.wait_for(12s) so backend boots regardless of DB; (c) /api/health endpoint reports mongo reachability + integration wiring so misconfigs are visible without shell access. Preview remains fully green; prod fix requires user to correct MONGO_URL then hit /api/health for confirmation.
